items.heading: Borscht Ukrainian
details: Key ingredients: beetroot, cabbage, beef, sour cream
Simmer beef into a rich broth.
Add shredded beetroot, cabbage and other root vegetables.
Cook until the vegetables are tender and the soup turns deep red.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream and fresh dill.

items.heading: Varenyky
details: Key ingredients: dough, potato, cheese, onion
Make a simple dough of flour, water and egg.
Fill rolled dough circles with mashed potato and cheese.
Fold and crimp into half-moon dumplings.
Boil until they float, then top with fried onion before serving.
